title: Projectivity and flatness over the endomorphism ring of a finitely generated $(H, {\mathcal C})$-comodule
summary: Let $k$ be a commutative ring, $H$ a bialgebra over $k$, $A$ an $H$-algebra and $\mathcal C$ an $(H,A)$-coring, i.e a left $(H,A)$-bimodule which is an $A$-coring in a compatible way. Left $(H,A)$-bimodules and their deformations play a fundamental role in the study of the differential geometry of noncommutative manifolds. Let $Λ$ be a right $(H,{\mathcal C})$-comodule. The $k$-module $_HEnd^{\mathcal C}(Λ)$ of right $(H,{\mathcal C})$-colinear maps from $Λ$ to $Λ$ is a ring. Let us assume that $\mathcal C$ is flat as a left $A$-module.
